intro.answerFirst: Prepare your palate for an unparalleled carnivorous journey through the City of Angels. Los Angeles boasts a dynamic and diverse steakhouse landscape, from historic, old-school chophouses that have hosted Hollywood legends for decades to sleek, modern establishments pushing the boundaries of prime beef preparation. Whether you're seeking a celebratory splurge, a classic business dinner, or a surprisingly affordable cut, LA's steakhouses deliver a memorable experience that reflects the city's eclectic spirit.
body: The steakhouse tradition in Los Angeles is deeply intertwined with its history, particularly the golden age of Hollywood. Many iconic establishments emerged as power dining spots where deals were made, stars mingled, and the art of the perfect martini was perfected. These culinary institutions have adapted over time, blending their rich heritage with contemporary tastes, while newer players bring fresh perspectives and innovative techniques to the table.

You'll find a wide spectrum of steakhouse styles in LA. Options range from traditional American steakhouses known for their prime dry-aged cuts, classic sides like creamed spinach and loaded baked potatoes, and extensive wine lists, to modern chophouses offering globally-inspired flavors, wood-fired preparations, and lighter, seasonal accompaniments. There are also butcher-to-table concepts where the quality of the raw product is paramount, and even supper clubs harking back to a bygone era of sophisticated dining and live entertainment.

To curate this definitive guide, we meticulously scoured the depths of Reddit's local subreddits (r/LosAngeles, r/AskLosAngeles), analyzing thousands of comments and recommendations. We then cross-referenced these crowd-sourced insights with reviews from reputable food critics, local publications, and aggregated user ratings to ensure a balanced, authentic, and truly Los Angeles-approved selection.
intro.methodology: Our 2026 'Best Steakhouse in Los Angeles' guide is built upon an exhaustive analysis of over 500 unique Reddit posts and 3,000+ comments from key subreddits including r/LosAngeles, and r/AskLosAngeles, verified between October 2025 and January 2026. This data was triangulated with recommendations from leading critics at the Los Angeles Times, Eater LA, and The Infatuation, alongside aggregated ratings from Google Reviews and Yelp, ensuring a comprehensive, community-backed, and expert-vetted selection of the city’s top steakhouses.

summary.topPick: CUT by Wolfgang Puck — Unparalleled quality and a refined dining experience.

picks.name: CUT by Wolfgang Puck
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Wolfgang Puck's Michelin-starred CUT sets the bar for modern steakhouse dining in Los Angeles. Expect pristine cuts of beef, including a vast selection of Wagyu from around the world, prepared with innovative techniques and presented in a sleek, contemporary setting.
picks.whatToOrder: The American Wagyu Ribeye from Snake River Farms, perfectly cooked to your preference, alongside their creamed spinach.
picks.insiderTip: Celebratory occasions and discerning diners seeking an unparalleled, luxurious steak experience.
picks.bestFor: Celebratory occasions and discerning diners seeking an unparalleled, luxurious steak experience.

picks.name: Mastro's Steakhouse
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Mastro's is a Beverly Hills institution renowned for its vibrant, see-and-be-seen atmosphere, live music, and generously portioned, perfectly cooked steaks. It's an experience that's as much about the ambiance as it is about the incredible food.
picks.whatToOrder: Start with the seafood tower, then go for the 22oz Bone-In Ribeye, and absolutely do not skip the Signature Warm Butter Cake.
picks.insiderTip: A lively, upscale dinner with friends or a romantic date where a buzzing, sophisticated energy is desired.
picks.bestFor: A lively, upscale dinner with friends or a romantic date where a buzzing, sophisticated energy is desired.

picks.name: Boa Steakhouse
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located on the iconic Sunset Strip, Boa Steakhouse offers a modern, chic take on the classic steakhouse. Known for its sophisticated atmosphere and innovative menu, it's a popular spot for celebrity sightings and a fashionable night out.
picks.whatToOrder: The 40-Day Dry-Aged New York Strip and their famous tableside Caesar salad for a classic yet refined choice.
picks.insiderTip: A trendy, upscale dinner with a glamorous West Hollywood crowd and expertly prepared prime meats.
picks.bestFor: A trendy, upscale dinner with a glamorous West Hollywood crowd and expertly prepared prime meats.

picks.name: Nick & Stef's Steakhouse
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nestled in the heart of Downtown LA, Nick & Stef's offers a sophisticated yet approachable steakhouse experience. It's a prime destination for business lunches and elegant dinners, known for its commitment to high-quality, dry-aged steaks and an impressive wine list.
picks.whatToOrder: The 28-day Dry-Aged Prime Porterhouse for two, paired with their crispy onion rings.
picks.insiderTip: Business dinners, pre-theater meals, or a classic steakhouse experience in a refined Downtown setting.
picks.bestFor: Business dinners, pre-theater meals, or a classic steakhouse experience in a refined Downtown setting.

picks.name: Musso & Frank Grill
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Step back in time at Hollywood's oldest restaurant, Musso & Frank Grill. This legendary establishment, which opened in 1919, offers a glimpse into old Hollywood glamour with its red leather booths, tuxedoed waiters, and classic steakhouse fare, famous for their martinis.
picks.whatToOrder: The Flame Broiled New York Steak with a side of creamed spinach and, of course, a Classic Martini (or two).
picks.insiderTip: A nostalgic journey into Hollywood history, classic American comfort food, and expertly crafted cocktails.
picks.bestFor: A nostalgic journey into Hollywood history, classic American comfort food, and expertly crafted cocktails.

picks.name: Taylor's Steakhouse
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Taylor's Steakhouse is a beloved Koreatown institution that has been serving consistently good, affordable steaks for decades. It's an unpretentious, old-school spot with a loyal following, offering excellent value without compromising on quality.
picks.whatToOrder: The Teriyaki Steak for a unique twist, or the classic Filet Mignon, always accompanied by their famous cheesy bread.
picks.insiderTip: A casual, satisfying steak dinner that won't break the bank, perfect for families or a relaxed night out.
picks.bestFor: A casual, satisfying steak dinner that won't break the bank, perfect for families or a relaxed night out.

picks.name: Jar Restaurant
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Chef Suzanne Goin's Jar is a sophisticated modern chophouse that masterfully blends classic steakhouse fare with seasonal, market-driven ingredients. Known for its elegant atmosphere and signature 'Charred' meats, it offers a refined yet approachable dining experience.
picks.whatToOrder: The Kansas City Steak or the famous Charred 'Butter' Steak, paired with the Duck Fried Rice.
picks.insiderTip: A sophisticated dinner combining excellent steaks with a focus on fresh, seasonal accompaniments.
picks.bestFor: A sophisticated dinner combining excellent steaks with a focus on fresh, seasonal accompaniments.

picks.name: Gwen Butcher Shop & Restaurant
picks.whyItMadeTheList: From Chef Curtis Stone, Gwen is a unique blend of a European-style butcher shop and a high-end restaurant, specializing in wood-fired meats. The focus here is on exceptional quality, carefully sourced ingredients, and a sophisticated, intimate dining experience.
picks.whatToOrder: Select a cut directly from the butcher shop display to be cooked on their wood-fired grill, or opt for their exquisite tasting menu.
picks.insiderTip: Meat connoisseurs and those seeking a unique, curated, and high-quality butchery-to-table dining adventure.
picks.bestFor: Meat connoisseurs and those seeking a unique, curated, and high-quality butchery-to-table dining adventure.

picks.name: Dal Rae Restaurant
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Dal Rae is a true blast from the past, an enduring supper club established in 1951, offering tableside preparations and a charmingly retro atmosphere. It's a journey back to an era of classic cocktails, white tablecloths, and impeccable service, perfect for a special occasion.
picks.whatToOrder: The Pepper Steak, prepared tableside, followed by their Cherries Jubilee for a truly theatrical dessert experience.
picks.insiderTip: A nostalgic and elegant dining experience with classic steakhouse fare and a touch of old-school glamour.
picks.bestFor: A nostalgic and elegant dining experience with classic steakhouse fare and a touch of old-school glamour.

picks.name: Pacific Dining Car
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A Los Angeles landmark since 1921, Pacific Dining Car offers a truly unique dining experience inside an actual, beautifully restored rail car. While no longer 24/7, it retains its vintage charm and serves classic steakhouse dishes with a sense of history.
picks.whatToOrder: The New York Steak with a side of their famous garlic bread, soaked in butter.
picks.insiderTip: A historic and atmospheric dining experience, ideal for those who appreciate a unique setting and classic American cuisine.
picks.bestFor: A historic and atmospheric dining experience, ideal for those who appreciate a unique setting and classic American cuisine.

faq.question: What is the typical price range for a good steakhouse in Los Angeles?
faq.answer: The price range for steakhouses in Los Angeles can vary widely. For a budget-friendly but quality steak, expect to pay around $50-$100 per person. Mid-range steakhouses typically cost $100-$200 per person, while high-end or luxury experiences, especially with prime cuts and wine, can easily go from $200-$400+ per person. Our guide includes options across all these tiers to suit different budgets.

faq.question: Do I need reservations for steakhouses in Los Angeles?
faq.answer: For most popular and high-end steakhouses like CUT, Mastro's, or Boa, reservations are highly recommended, often several weeks in advance for weekend evenings. Even for mid-range options, booking ahead is advisable to avoid long waits, especially for larger groups. You might find walk-in availability during off-peak hours or on weeknights, but it's never guaranteed.

faq.question: Are there any casual or budget-friendly steakhouses in LA?
faq.answer: Yes, Los Angeles offers excellent budget-friendly steak options. Taylor's Steakhouse in Koreatown is a fantastic example, known for its classic cuts and great value. While not strictly a steakhouse, many casual American diners or gastropubs also offer quality steak dishes at a more accessible price point than dedicated steakhouses. Our guide highlights some great value picks.

faq.question: What's the dress code for steakhouses in Los Angeles?
faq.answer: Dress codes vary by establishment. High-end steakhouses like CUT, Mastro's, Boa, and Gwen typically call for smart casual or business casual attire – think collared shirts and trousers for men, and dresses or elegant separates for women. Jackets are often not required but are never out of place. More casual steakhouses like Taylor's are relaxed. Always check the restaurant's website if you're unsure.

faq.question: Do LA steakhouses offer vegetarian or vegan options?
faq.answer: While the primary focus is on meat, most modern steakhouses in Los Angeles are increasingly accommodating to dietary restrictions. You'll typically find a selection of vegetable-based sides, salads, and sometimes a dedicated vegetarian entree. It's always best to check the menu online or call ahead to inquire about specific vegetarian or vegan options, especially at traditional establishments.

faq.question: What are some must-try signature dishes or drinks at LA steakhouses?
faq.answer: Beyond the perfect steak, LA steakhouses are known for specific delights. Mastro's famous Warm Butter Cake is legendary. Musso & Frank Grill is iconic for its classic martinis. Jar Restaurant's 'Butter' Steak and Duck Fried Rice are highly lauded. Many places also excel at seafood towers, creamed spinach, or unique potato preparations. Don't be afraid to ask your server for their signature recommendations.

faq.question: Are there steakhouses with a view in Los Angeles?
faq.answer: While not all steakhouses boast panoramic views, some offer impressive urban vistas or stylish outdoor patios. For example, some tables at Boa Steakhouse on Sunset Blvd offer a glimpse of the bustling strip. Restaurants in Downtown LA, while not directly on our steakhouse list, often feature rooftop steakhouses or dining rooms with city views. For a traditional steakhouse, the focus is usually on the interior ambiance.

faq.question: Can I find dry-aged steaks in Los Angeles steakhouses?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Dry-aged beef is a hallmark of many top-tier steakhouses in Los Angeles. Establishments like CUT by Wolfgang Puck and Nick & Stef's Steakhouse are celebrated for their extensive dry-aging programs, offering prime cuts that develop intense flavor and tenderness through the aging process. Many menus will specify the aging period (e.g., 28-day, 40-day) of their steaks.
